witness_description: No certified counterexample; the claim is under-specified by the supplied quote.
refutation_explanation: The quote supplies no definitions of “component,” “moving,” “vi,” the ambient n-element set, disjointness, or which triples/configurations are admissible. Consequently, arithmetic assignments with s != n - L - 1 cannot be certified as instances of the described situation, so the bounded sweep neither refutes nor verifies the claim.
search_space: All 284 integer triples (n, L, s) with 1 <= n <= 8 and 0 <= L <= n, 0 <= s <= n, in lexicographic nested-loop order; 36 satisfy s = n - L - 1 and 248 do not. This is exhaustive only for these bounded arithmetic placeholders, not for component/move configurations.
